# Periodic Table – Royal Society of Chemistry

> > The Royal Society of Chemistry's interactive periodic table provides comprehensive element data, properties, discovery history, and multimedia content for educational and reference purposes.

This resource offers detailed information on all chemical elements including their properties, industrial applications, biological roles, and historical context. It combines interactive visualizations, podcasts, videos, and scientific references to make chemistry education accessible and engaging.

## Key Topics

- Periodic Table
- Chemical Elements
- Element Properties
- Element Discovery
- Industrial Applications
- Biological Role
- Noble Gases
- Alkali Metals
- Element Profile
- Natural Abundance
- Chemical Uses
- Visual Elements
- History of Chemistry
- Royal Society of Chemistry
- ChemSpider

## Interactive Periodic Table & Core Resources

- [Periodic Table – Royal Society of Chemistry](https://periodic-table.rsc.org): Interactive periodic table with element data, scarcity, discovery dates by RSC
- [Periodic Table: Trends](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/trends): Interactive visualization of element trends including density, electronegativity, ionization energy

## Element Reference Profiles

- [Hydrogen - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/1/hydrogen): Hydrogen element profile with properties, uses, SRI, podcasts, videos and images
- [Helium - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/2/helium): Helium element profile with properties, uses, industrial applications and noble gas data
- [Lithium - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/3/lithium): Lithium element profile with properties, battery technology uses and alkali metal data
- [Beryllium - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/4/beryllium): Beryllium element profile with chemical data, material properties and uses
- [Boron - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/5/boron): Boron element profile with properties, industrial applications and natural abundance
- [Carbon - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/6/carbon): Carbon element profile with allotropes, material applications and chemical structure
- [Nitrogen - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/7/nitrogen): Nitrogen element profile with industrial applications and biological role data
- [Oxygen - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/8/oxygen): Oxygen element profile with chemical uses, industrial applications and biological role
- [Fluorine - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/9/fluorine): Fluorine element profile with reactive properties, compounds and industrial applications
- [Neon - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/10/neon): Neon noble gas profile with lighting uses, cryogenic applications and element history
- [Sodium - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/11/sodium): Sodium element profile with compounds, biological role and natural abundance data
- [Magnesium - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/12/magnesium): Magnesium element profile with industrial applications, alloys and biological role
- [Aluminium - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/13/aluminium): Aluminium element profile with material science, alloys and industrial applications
- [Silicon - Element information, properties and uses](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/14/silicon): Silicon element profile with semiconductor properties, alloys and silicone applications

## Educational Content & History

- [Periodic Table: History](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/history): Explore element discovery history and scientists involved in periodic table development
- [Periodic Table: Podcast](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/podcast): Chemistry World podcast collection featuring stories behind each periodic table element
- [Periodic Table: Video](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/video): Video collection on elements featuring Visual Elements and Periodic Table of Videos

## Optional

- [Periodic Table: Alchemy](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/alchemy): Educational resource on alchemy and alchemical symbols in chemistry history
